Rux component scaffold.description: A full .rux component: template + style + script.

r-for loop.description: An element repeated over a list.

r-if conditional.description: An element shown only when a condition holds.

r-model input.description: A text input two-way bound to a signal.

interpolation.description: Interpolate a script expression into text.

path element.body: <path class="${1:mark}" d="${2:M 0 0 L 24 0 L 12 20 Z}" alt="${3:what it shows}" />
path element.description: Vector geometry. Paint it with `fill` / `stroke` in CSS, not with attributes.

path, bound.description: A path whose geometry is an expression. Two paths with the same command sequence morph under `transition: d`.

router.description: A router and its routes. First match wins, and `fallback` may sit anywhere among them.

guarded route.description: A route that refuses. `false` cancels, a string redirects, anything else allows. Runs before the history moves, so Back goes through it too.

link.description: A link. It matches `:current` when it names the path you are on.

r-transition.description: An element animated in and out. Style the two ends with `:enter-from` and `:leave-to`, and set the duration with the element's own `transition`.

transition rules.description: The three rules an `r-transition` needs: the duration on the element, and the hidden end on each side.

sticky heading.description: A box that rides its scroller's edge, then clamps to its own parent. Needs at least one inset or it never moves.

computed.description: Derived state. A declaration, not a call: there is no computed(|| ...). Refreshed in declaration order.

effect.description: Runs when what it read changes, and once on load. A block, not a call.

mounted.description: Runs once the document is on screen.

query.description: Find an element by CSS selector, in a handler, against the frame already laid out.

emit.description: A component telling its caller something happened. The caller listens with `@name`.

slot.description: Where the caller's children land. What is written inside is the default.

select input.description: A combo box bound to a signal.

checkbox input.description: A checkbox. Its live state is matched by `:checked`.
